text:
sarah (AE): Heads up — Mosaic Health POC ready for signature. Procurement flagged MSA redlines (data residency + HSM), DPA requires subprocessors list, and they asked for SLA 99.9 with a penalty. Also PO net30. Can legal + finance advise on countersign path? :eyes:

mike (Legal): Thanks. Can you attach the customer's redline vs our standard MSA? Key Qs: are they insisting on customer-managed KMS? If yes, we'll need the Private package addendum. Also SLA penalty language — propose cap at fees paid in 3 months.

ana (Solutions Eng): On POC side — they want Dedicated pool for predictable latency. We agreed to 1-week trial with 100k tokens/day. Pricing addendum needed: waive overage for POC, apply credits. I'll paste order form snippet.

ana (Solutions Eng): ```
Order form:
- SKU: dedicated-poc-1week
- Quantity: 1 pool
- Credits: $5,000
- Billing: Net 30
- PO: MH-4321
```

katie (Procurement): Net 30 is ok, finance needs a PO number (MH-4321 noted). Are we ok with the customer's annex that requires exec signature order: CFO -> VP Ops? Also need invoice contact.

mike (Legal): If they want customer-managed KMS/HSM, require SOW addendum + attestation. For the DPA, we'll provide subprocessors list and a regional carveout for backups (US only). I'll draft redline and push penalty cap.

raj (Eng): FYI, enabling Dedicated in their AZ is straightforward, Private/VPC adds ~2 weeks. If sales commits to a delivery SLA in the MSA that creates risk. Recommend delivery milestones live in SOW, not MSA.

sarah (AE): Agreed — avoid timeline in MSA. Mike — can you confirm SOW approach and draft redline by EOD tomorrow? Katie — confirm PO attachment workflow.

mike (Legal): SOW-with-milestones is ok. I'll push back on uncapped SLA penalties and limit remedies to fee credits. Also authorize DocuSign countersign; wet-ink allowed for int'l.

contracts-bot: Template MSA v4.2: https://redwood.internal/contracts/msa_v4.2.pdf. Run `/contracts compare customer_redline.pdf` to auto-generate diff.

katie (Procurement): Confirmed: attach PO MH-4321 to order form, billing contact is billing@redwood-inference.com. Will confirm invoicing cadence with finance and share AP contact.

ana (Solutions Eng): Ops note — customer asked about KV cache exportability. Not in scope for POC. I'll mark as optional feature in SOW.

sarah (AE): Next steps: Mike to deliver legal redline by EOD tomorrow, Katie to confirm PO mapping and AP contact, Ana to update order form and SOW bullets, Raj to confirm deployment ETA if Dedicated vs Private. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:

mike (Legal): On it. tagging @ana and @katie — please DM any customer docs (redlines, annexes).
